indications.description: Adult patients with symptomatic metastatic basal cell carcinoma.
Adult patients with locally advanced basal cell carcinoma inappropriate for surgery or radiotherapy.

schedule.pattern: Continuous every day; no planned weekly or four-week drug break
schedule.stop_basis: Until progression or unacceptable toxicity, with regular benefit review
schedule.food: With or without food; same time each day
schedule.administration: Swallow whole with 200 mL water; do not open or crush
schedule.missed: Skip the missed dose and resume the next scheduled dose; never double
schedule.vomited: No source-specific replacement algorithm; contact the team before an extra dose
schedule.interruption: Only according to the treating team. Four-week trial interruptions are context, not a mandatory maximum or automatic restart rule.

before: Pregnancy Prevention Programme assessment/registration for all patients
Applicable negative pregnancy test and contraception safeguards
during: FBC, renal and liver profile every four weeks
For women of childbearing potential: medically supervised pregnancy tests monthly, even with amenorrhoea
Review symptoms, weight/intake, tolerability, medicines and benefit
individual_plan: Clinical disease review, scans and any tumour-specific tests as directed; no universal imaging or tumour-marker schedule
CK and renal assessment when muscle symptoms/CK concern warrants; no mandatory routine CK timetable in these sources
Careful adverse-reaction surveillance in severe renal impairment
after: Continue the applicable 24-month and 2-month reproductive/donation precautions
Follow the individual cancer follow-up and symptom plan; no universal post-treatment scan schedule supplied

source.document: EMA Erivedge product information, updated 5 November 2025

contraception_source.document: EMA Erivedge product information, updated 5 November 2025

pregnancy_counselling: WCBP: two recommended methods including one highly effective plus one barrier, unless committed abstinence; continue during treatment and for 24 months after. Amenorrhoea does not remove pregnancy precautions.
Men: condom with spermicide if available, even after vasectomy, when having sex with a female partner; continue during treatment and for 2 months after.
No breastfeeding or blood donation during treatment and for 24 months after final dose. No semen donation during treatment or for 2 months after.
Promptly report possible pregnancy, missed periods, contraception changes or partner pregnancy to the team.
WCBP: initial prescribing and dispensing by day 7 with test date counted as day 1; supplies limited to 28 days and renewed prescription required.

supportive_care.antiemetic: Local symptom/rescue plan; no universal scheduled prophylactic prescription inferred
symptom_support: Discuss cramps, taste change, weight loss, appetite, diarrhoea/constipation and hydration early
Do not use St John's wort; have prescription, over-the-counter and herbal products reviewed
Discuss fertility and preservation before starting

consent.mechanism: Vismodegib blocks Smoothened in the Hedgehog signalling pathway, which helps drive many basal cell carcinomas. This is an oral targeted treatment.
consent.goals: Control or shrink an eligible advanced BCC; individual benefit is uncertain and needs repeat review.
urgent_effects: Blistering/peeling rash, sores or systemic illness suggesting a severe skin reaction
Severe muscle pain or weakness, dark urine or reduced urine needing urgent assessment
Jaundice or symptoms suggesting liver injury
consent.red_flag_qualification: Symptoms need assessment; do not describe every symptom as proof of a toxicity diagnosis.
consent.source_specific_permanent_rule: If SJS/TEN, DRESS or AGEP occurred on vismodegib, it must never be restarted.

anatomical_anchoring: Head/mouth: taste changes and their effect on eating
Hair/skin: hair loss plus distinct urgent severe-rash pathway
Muscles/limbs: cramps, muscle pain/weakness; urgent severe symptoms
Gut/nutrition: nausea, bowel changes, appetite, weight and hydration
Liver: liver injury symptoms and review
Reproductive system: pregnancy, fertility and post-treatment precautions

evidence.design: SHH4476g/ERIVANCE phase II, single-arm, non-comparative advanced BCC study
evidence.interpretation: Keep metastatic and locally advanced cohorts and assessment time/assessor separate. Response is not cure or a randomised survival benefit; do not combine with later investigator-assessed rates.

education_reference.role: User-supplied NCCN patient education reference; does not set NCCP dosing or eligibility.

patient_pack.page1: Continuous daily schedule, regular review/tests and between-review expectations
patient_pack.page2: Preserve detailed anatomical toxicity anchors and explanations; do not substitute stick-figure anatomy
patient_pack.page3: Front/back wallet card, automatic 00236 patient QR, cutting/printing and webapp instructions; ongoing-treatment review record rather than fixed-cycle completion stamps
patient_pack.handbook: Complete logical offline reading sequence, not reliance on hyperlinks. Placeholder contacts clearly labelled.
